messages:
sara: kicking off canary for infra-service chart v2.4.0 now, using values override to bump replicas for canary only. will monitor for 15m window

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for release=infra-service chart=infra-service v2.4.0 namespace=prod-canary. canary-size=5% window=15m. docs: https://redwood.internal/deploys/1775012345

jamie: noted. ping me if latency spikes or 5xx > 1%

leo: which values file are you using? the last time we forgot to pin imagePullPolicy and had restarts

sara: using repo/values/canary-2026-03-20.yaml (snippet below)
```yaml
image:
  tag: "v2.4.0"
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
replicaSelector:
  canaryWeight: 5
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 100m
    memory: 256Mi
```

anita: can we pin chart dependency versions before the rollout? last week the auth-subchart bumped and changed the env var name

jamie: good call. we should add a preflight that checks chart.lock vs repo lockfile. if mismatch -> abort

tom: also watch PDBs — if new pods take too long to become ready we might exceed disruption budget. set maxUnavailable to 10% for canary namespace

deploy-bot: Canary healthcheck: 5/10 pods READY, avg start latency=2.1s, 4xx rate=0.2% , 5xx rate=0.9%

leo: 5xx creeping up, I'm seeing a stacktrace in the canary logs: NPE from auth client on startup. likely breaking change in auth-subchart

sara: okay hold canary, marking rollout as paused. Do we rollback or try to patch values to use previous auth image?

jamie: if it's a subchart/API contract issue, rollback to previous chart version. revert to v2.3.x and pin auth-subchart to 1.8.2. trying a quick revert is safest for prod

anita: agree — open a rollback playbook and notify infra-sre. include the helm rollback command and the chart lock change in the PR

tom: suggested rollback command:
```
helm rollback infra-service-prod 42 --namespace=prod
kubectl rollout status deploy/infra-service -n prod --timeout=5m
```

leo: also update the values in git: set auth.image.tag=1.8.2 and update Chart.lock so future canaries don't pick up the bad auth image

sara: initiating rollback now, will post results

deploy-bot: Started rollout revert for release=infra-service target_revision=42 namespace=prod user=sara

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. kubernetes: 3/3 pods ready. duration=2m14s. IncidentChannel: #incidents if you want postmortem

jamie: nice. please file a short postmortem with root cause (auth-subchart API change) and checklist addition to pin subchart deps for all prod charts

anita: I'll add a pre-merge CI check: fail if Chart.lock differs from chart.lock.example or if any subchart version is a floating tag like ">=1.8"

leo: can we also add an alert rule in console: canary-5xx > 0.5% over 5m triggers auto-pause and notify eng-releases?

sara: yes please. I'll follow up with a PR to add the alert and update the canary values to include pdb maxUnavailable=10%

tom: thumbs up. postmortem owner? sara or anita?

sara: I can own it, will draft and loop in auth team

jamie: thanks everyone. short and clean rollback, let’s keep the chart pinning work prioritized this sprint :thumbsup:
